messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: Viscous friction depends on the angular velocity and the damping coefficient. Coefficient values determine how quickly energy dissipates in the system. System dynamics require including this term when damping is significant. Significant damping alters the natural frequency and amplitude of oscillations. Oscillations are modeled with a second-order differential equation incorporating these effects.
